pr_title: Add supporter required placeholder in beatmap listing overlay
pr_body:
Fixes #13530

Added ```SupporterRequiredDrawable``` in ```osu.Game.Overlays.BeatmapListingOverlay``` for non-supporter users applied supporter-only filters, referencing [web version](https://osu.ppy.sh/beatmapsets?played=played&r=XH)'s layout

Changed ```osu.Game.Overlays.BeatmapListing.BeatmapListingFilterControl``` to pass ```searchControl``` in ```SearchFinished``` for text in ```SupporterRequiredDrawable```

Tests added in ```osu.Game.Tests.Visual.Online.TestSceneBeatmapListingOverlay```
Tested on:
- non-supporter user with/without supporter-only filters, with/without search results
- supporter user with/without supporter-only filters, with/without search results
pr_comments: I've applied further cleanups and think this is mostly ready to go, but I am not going to merge this without a second approval because I'm not sure whether I'll get agreement on how the search result structure is set up. It makes sense to me but I do want to run that through another pair of eyes first.

I'm using ```BeatmapsStrings.ListingSearchSupporterFilterQuoteDefault``` to get the supporter required text. It takes two strings but that makes the passed text (```ListingSearchFiltersPlayed``` and ```ListingSearchFiltersRank```) would not be translated in-game.

That is going to require support of localisation in `TextFlowContainer` and co., or a mechanism to format `LocalisableString`s using other `LocalisableString`s. I do not recommend you attempt to add this.
